findings.issue: Doc says "The new duration budget is `max(prior, elapsed) + M`", which is only true when `--extend-minutes` is passed. `.skilled/commands/deep/assets/deep-review.yaml:542` computes `const addedMinutes = hasMinutes ? Number(extendMinutesRaw) : priorMaxDurationMinutes`, and :544-546 computes `priorMaxDurationMinutes > 0 || hasMinutes ? Math.max(priorMaxDurationMinutes, elapsedMinutesAtExtension) + addedMinutes : priorMaxDurationMinutes`. So a bare `--extend=N` on a 120-minute run writes max(prior, elapsed) + 120, not max(prior, elapsed); and a run whose `maxDurationMinutes` is 0 keeps 0 rather than becoming elapsed. The section claims to cover the iteration and duration budget but omits the unset-flag default that `.skilled/commands/deep/review.md:108` states as "default the prior `maxDurationMinutes`".

Doc says "A review run with a configured minIterations floor returns CONTINUE with minIterationsNotReached until its iteration count reaches the floor, so a review never stops before the floor." The floor only holds a stop candidate: `runtime/scripts/convergence.cjs` returns STOP earlier on the iteration cap (:1141) and on the consecutive-failure halt (:1148, `CONSECUTIVE_FAILURE_LIMIT = 3`), both before the floor check at :1195, and stuck recovery also outranks it. A review with `minIterations: 5` that fails three iterations in a row halts at iteration 3 with stopReason `error`, below the floor. The sibling feature page states the accurate form ("A stop candidate below the floor never ends the review", `loop-lifecycle/min-iterations-floor.md:24`) but its own frontmatter description (line 3) repeats this absolute.
